meta.name: faceless-explainer
meta.description: Turn arbitrary text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: there is no site or footage to capture, so the visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. Not a video built from a website (/product-launch-video — promo or tour). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把任意文章或笔记快速变成一个视觉讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头有文字资料想做成视频,又不想真人出镜或录屏
copy.tagline_en: Create a visual explainer video from any text
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to repurpose written content into video without filming or screen capture

howto.what: 把任意文本（文章、笔记、主题等）变成一部无真人出镜的解说视频：Claude会规划教学故事、选择设计预设、生成故事板和配音，逐帧构建画面（文字排版、抽象图形、图表等），最后输出视频文件。
howto.when: 当用户提供文章、笔记、主题等文本，并要求制作解说视频时触发；也适用于概念分解、教程等场景。

say.text: 把这篇关于复利的文章做成解说视频
say.note: Claude会先确认简报，然后生成故事板和脚本。

say.text: 用这段笔记做一个概念讲解视频，用男声
say.note: 会按指定声音生成配音。

say.text: 把这个主题做成无旁白的视频
say.note: 生成无配音、无背景音乐的视频。

howto.what_en: Turn arbitrary text (article, notes, topic, brief) into a faceless explainer video: Claude plans a teaching story, picks a design preset, generates storyboard and voiceover, builds each frame (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams), and outputs a video file.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user provides text (article, notes, topic, etc.) and asks for an explainer video; also for concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles.

say_en.text: Turn this article about compound interest into an explainer video.
say_en.note: Claude confirms the brief and starts building.

say_en.text: Make a concept explainer from these notes, using a male voice.
Make a silent video from this topic.
say_en.note: Produces a video with no narration or music.
